string.name: schedule_template_meeting_prep_prompt
string.value: Check today's meetings in my Lark calendar and phone calendar. For each meeting that needs preparing, use schedule_followup to set up a prep 10 minutes before it: related docs, notes from the last meeting, open questions, and the points I should make. If no meeting needs preparing today, just say so briefly.

string.name: schedule_template_weekly_report_prompt
string.value: Draft this week's report for me: from my Lark calendar, meeting notes, docs and messages, sum up what got done this week, progress and results, problems, and next week's plan. Include the main changes the agents on my computers finished this week. Give me a draft first and ask whether to change anything. Don't send it.

string.name: schedule_template_end_of_day_prompt
string.value: End-of-day review: which messages I haven't answered today, what I promised others and haven't done, which agents on my computers are still running or waiting on me, and which meetings tomorrow morning need preparing. List them by urgency, then ask me which ones need a reminder.
